answer_1.quote: We evaluate the model on the task of creative image captioning (Section 2).
answer_1.outputs: creative captions for images and rewritten/infilled text spans

answer_2.quote: we calculated the Rouge-L recall score ... and ... we measure the count of unique trigrams ... and calculate the perplexity of the final captions using a pre-trained GPT2 model.

answer_4.quote: we ask users to complete a survey ... and we ask a 'third-party' human annotator ... to compare the captions pairwise ... and asked to pick the more creative caption of the two.
answer_4.guideline: Survey questions: helpfulness, grammaticality, satisfaction; Pairwise: choose the better (more descriptive/figurative) caption with relevance.
